features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 DEX; +2 WIS; -2 CON.

features.name: Size
features.description: Small: +1 size AC, +1 size attack, -1 CMB and CMD, +4 size Stealth.

effects.textValue: Small

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid Plant: counts as BOTH humanoid and plant for targeted effects; not immune to mind-affecting, poison, paralysis, polymorph, or stun by virtue of being plant.

effects.textValue: Humanoid and Plant (dual type for targeted effects)

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common, Mandragoran. High-Intelligence options: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Sylvan.

effects.textValue: Common; Mandragoran

features.name: Elemental Resistance
features.description: Earth resistance 5.

effects.textValue: Earth 5

features.name: Hydrated Vitality
features.description: Submerged entirely in natural non-stagnant water: fast healing 2 for 1 round. Daily healing maximum 2 hit points per character level. Stagnant, poisoned or artificially trapped water does not activate.

effects.textValue: Fast healing 2 for 1 round per valid full immersion; max healed 2x level HP/day

features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

effects.textValue: +1 natural armor AC

features.name: Plant Resistance
features.description: +2 racial saves against mind-affecting, paralysis, poison and polymorph; immune sleep effects. Not broad Plant type immunity.

effects.textValue: Sleep effects

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: +4 racial Stealth in marshes, jungles and forested terrain.

features.name: In Tune with the Earth
features.description: Effective caster level +1 when casting earth-descriptor spells, not early access to higher spell levels or powers.

effects.textValue: +1 effective level for earth-descriptor spells; no early feature access

features.name: Spell-Like Ability
features.description: 1/day photosynthesis as spell-like ability (caster level = class level).

effects.textValue: 1/day Photosynthesis, CL=class level; spell entry external

features.name: Terrain Stride
features.description: Ignore natural difficult terrain in forests; magically altered terrain applies normally.

effects.textValue: Ignore natural forest difficult terrain only

features.name: Shriek
features.description: 1/day standard action: creatures in 30-ft spread Will save (DC 10 + half character level + WIS mod) or nauseated 1d4 rounds. Sonic, mind-affecting.

effects.textValue: 30-ft spread, standard 1/day, Will DC 10+floor(level/2)+WIS mod, nausea 1d4 rds, sonic mind-affecting

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Weapons with “mandragoran” in name count as martial weapons.

effects.textValue: Treat Mandragoran weapons as martial

features.name: Bioluminescence
features.description: At will cause body to glow as a torch.

effects.textValue: At-will torch equivalent body light

features.name: Sunlight Sustenance
features.description: Needs water not food; with >=6 hr sunlight daily needs 1/4 normal water. After >2 days without adequate sunlight becomes fatigued; >1 week becomes exhausted until receives 6 hr sunlight. One hour of daylight spell meets daily need.

effects.textValue: Conditional reduced water, fatigue, exhaustion, daylight spell alternative; no food

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: Double vision distance in dim light compared with Hume.

effects.textValue: double range in dim light

features.name: Temperature Vulnerability
features.description: -4 Fortitude saves versus environmental effects.

features.name: Vulnerable to Fire
features.description: 150% fire damage unless immune, -2 saves versus fire spells/effects, and opposing caster gets +2 caster-level check using these effects.

effects.textValue: Fire damage x1.5 unless immune; -2 saves fire; attacker +2 CL on fire effects

features.name: Weakened by Cold
features.description: On ice damage, Fort save DC=10+half damage suffered; fail staggered for 1 round.

effects.textValue: Ice damage -> Fort DC 10 + floor(damage/2) -> stagger 1 round on fail

features.name: Bower Born
features.description: +2 racial Diplomacy and Handle Animal checks. Replaces Camouflage.

features.name: Buoyant
features.description: Swim speed 20 ft; +4 competence Swim checks. Replaces Camouflage, In Tune with the Earth.

effects.textValue: 20-foot swim speed

features.name: Burned One
features.description: Choose fire OR lightning resistance 5 permanently. Replaces Plant Resistance, Vulnerable to Fire.

effects.textValue: One selected Fire/Lightning resistance 5, not both

features.name: Cactuar Kin
features.description: Natural/unarmed attackers touching this mandragora suffer 1d3 piercing; grappling opponent also 1d3 each round. Replaces Plant Resistance.

effects.textValue: Natural/unarmed attackers touching this mandragora suffer 1d3 piercing; grappling opponent also 1d3 each round.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Two primary claws dealing 1d3 damage each. Replaces Shriek.

effects.textValue: Two primary claws dealing 1d3 damage each.

features.name: Dark Root
features.description: Darkvision 60 ft and burrow 15 ft. Replaces Low-Light Vision, Bioluminescence.

features.name: Edible Mushrooms
features.description: 1/day feed up to maximum of 1 or CON modifier Medium creatures for 24h. Replaces Spell-Like Ability.

effects.textValue: 1/day feed up to maximum of 1 or CON modifier Medium creatures for 24h.

features.name: Evergreen
features.description: Choose ice OR wind resistance 5 permanently. Replaces Plant Resistance, Weakened by Cold.

effects.textValue: One selected Ice/Wind resistance 5, not both

features.name: Intoxicating Aroma
features.description: 1/day standard action: target creatures within 30 ft Will DC 10+half character level+CHA mod or fascinated 1d4 rounds. Replaces Spell-Like Ability.

effects.textValue: 1/day standard action: target creatures within 30 ft Will DC 10+half character level+CHA mod or fascinated 1d4 rounds.

features.name: Malboro Kin
features.description: Water resistance 5 and stench with poison sickening: creatures sharing square, swallowing whole, or Scent creatures within 10 feet Fort DC 10+half level+CON mod or sickened 1 round; save grants immunity for 24h. Replaces Elemental Resistance, Plant Resistance.

effects.textValue: Water resistance 5 and stench with poison sickening: creatures sharing square, swallowing whole, or Scent creatures within 10 feet Fort DC 10+half level+CON mod or sickened 1 round; save grants immunity for 24h.

features.name: Natural Magic
features.description: If CHA >=11: 1/day each detect poison, goodberry, purify food and drink; CL=character level, DC=10+spell level+CHA mod. Replaces Spell-Like Ability.

effects.textValue: If CHA >=11: 1/day each detect poison, goodberry, purify food and drink; CL=character level, DC=10+spell level+CHA mod.

features.name: Ochu Kin
features.description: 1/day standard action poisonous spore cloud radius 10 ft for 1 round; inhalers Will DC 10+half character level+CON mod or dazed 1 round; holding breath avoids, mandragora immune. Replaces Plant Resistance.

effects.textValue: 1/day standard action poisonous spore cloud radius 10 ft for 1 round; inhalers Will DC 10+half character level+CON mod or dazed 1 round; holding breath avoids, mandragora immune.

features.name: Pestilent
features.description: Immunity poison and disease. Replaces Plant Resistance.

effects.textValue: Poison and disease

features.name: Photosynthetic Regrowth
features.description: Recover lost HP hourly instead of daily while in direct sunlight for each full hour. Replaces Natural Armor.

effects.textValue: Recover lost HP hourly instead of daily while in direct sunlight for each full hour.

features.name: Pithy Toughness
features.description: Toughness bonus feat. Replaces Plant Resistance.

effects.textValue: Toughness bonus feat

effects.textValue: +2 natural armor only while current HP < max HP/2

effects.textValue: Stand from prone as swift action; +2 racial CMD versus bull rush or trip while on ground.

features.description: Immediate action to root feet granting +4 racial CMD against bull rush or trip while standing on ground. Replaces Hydrated Vitality.

effects.textValue: Immediate action to root feet granting +4 racial CMD against bull rush or trip while standing on ground.

features.description: Two primary tentacle attacks 1d4 each with 10-ft reach for tentacles only. Replaces Shriek.

effects.textValue: Two primary tentacle attacks 1d4 each with 10-ft reach for tentacles only.

features.description: +1 racial Fortitude saves and +2 saves against fire spells/effects. Replaces Plant Resistance, Vulnerable to Fire.
